title: Caravel Trade
summary: Private peer-to-peer order-book templates exchanging testnet TARI and cUSD, a placeholder token with no value. Source describes whole-order fills, owner cancellation and a 1% TARI fee split: 0.7% Caravel and 0.3% burned. November 5 review: README revision 4f755d3 remains unchanged, documenting source tooling 0.47 and historical deployed 0.46.1 binaries. Its published order-board component returned “not found” in Veil at epoch 12,882 after the November 2 reset notice. The public Caravel entry reaches wallet creation or recovery before Trade. The October 23 README recording remains an accurate source walkthrough; its deployment claims are historical. No wallet, order or trade was created. The linked October 27 Tari Show discusses projects; it is not a Trade application demo.
